---
title: "授权"
description: "授权（八爪鱼RPA 开放 API 接口）"
---

## **请求**

| **Url** | https://api-rpa.bazhuayu.com/api/v1/identity/authentication/password |
| --- | --- |
| **请求方式** | **POST** |

### **1. 请求头**

| **字段** | **值** |
| --- | --- |
| Content-Type | application/json |

### 2. 请求参数

| **参数名称** | **类型** | **必须** | **描述** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| loginName | string | 是 | 账号用户名 |
| password | string | 是 | 账号密码 |

### 3. 请求示例

请求体：

```
{
    "loginName": "RPA账号",
    "password": "RPA账号密码"
}
```

### 4. 返回结果

| **参数名称** | **类型** | **必须** | **描述** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| accessToken | string | 是 | Token |
| accessTokenExpirationTime | string | 是 | Token 过期时间 |
